name: skills-mcp
description: Hub-owned skills delivery over MCP: metadata-only discovery plus on-demand content (plan Task F1).

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List available skills (metadata only). Skill content is never returned here — it costs a read_skill call. Screened (malicious-shaped) skills are quarantined and surfaced with their findings.

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description: Read one skill's full content by name. This is the only delivery path for skill content. Quarantined (malicious-shaped) or level-locked skills are refused.

discovery.note: Complete, stable tools/list is always served. This card carries a compact index (names, descriptions, risk hints) for hosts that progressively disclose model-visible definitions; tool definitions are never made connection-local or model-use-dependent.
